The client's `UIRenderer`: a tree is opened as a `CTMLScreen`, over the screen that was showing when it opened, and a link goes through minecraft's own confirm screen.

```java
import net.tutla.craftytml.client.render.ScreenRenderer;
```

## Members

### `public ScreenRenderer()`

Opens each tree over whatever screen is showing when it is shown.

### `public ScreenRenderer(Screen parent)`

Opens the first tree over this screen, and every one after it over whatever is showing then: the way to open something from a screen that is still being built, which is not showing yet.

### `public void show(String name, DOMTreeElement tree, DOMContext ctx)`
